## 6.1.5-ohos-1.0.1 - 2026.9

* Fixed `pub get` warning where `flutter_inappwebview:windows` referenced `flutter_inappwebview_windows` as the default plugin but the dependency was missing, by adding the `flutter_inappwebview_windows` path dependency. ([#323](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/issues/323))
* Fixed keep-alive WebView crash `TypeError: Cannot read property getController of null` when switching from background to foreground with ArkUI rebuild on OpenHarmony. ([#322](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/322))
* Fixed Web component `keyboardAvoidMode` restored to `RESIZE_VISUAL` on OpenHarmony to prevent page deformation when the soft keyboard appears. ([#322](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/326))
* Fixed empty `AlertDialog` shown by `onJsBeforeUnload` default handler when `message` is empty on OpenHarmony (e.g. prompt bridge navigation triggering beforeunload polyfill); skip dialog and confirm navigation instead. Aligned `notImplemented()` with Android default behavior.([#328](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/328)).
* Fixed `goBack` landing on a duplicate history entry (same URL as the page the back navigation started from) instead of the previous page when the history stack contains JS-redirect (`location.replace`) entries on OpenHarmony: the back/forward navigation allowance is now decremented at page-begin (history.back()/forward() do not always trigger URL interception), and duplicate back history entries are auto-skipped by calling `goBack` again. Added a redirect-chain test page (`redirect_test_demo.dart`) to the Example app and redirect test pages to the test Node server. ([#330](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/330))
* Fixed `CustomPathHandler` via `WebViewAssetLoader` returning empty (0-byte) responses for JS, SVG, and other assets on OpenHarmony — `Uint8Array` from Dart was passed directly to `WebResourceResponse.setResponseData()`, which only accepts `string` or `ArrayBuffer`; now converts via `WebResourceResponseHelper.applyBytesToWebResourceResponse` (text-like MIME → UTF-8 string, binary → `ArrayBuffer`). ([#327](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/issues/327))

## 6.1.5-ohos-1.0.0

* TAG 6.1.5-ohos-1.0.0. ([#273](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/273))
* Added Flutter 3.22 and Flutter 3.35 support with updated DevEco Studio and SDK compatibility matrix (same TAG covers 3.22 / 3.27 / 3.35). ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed MethodChannel handlers missing top-level try-catch so exceptions no longer leave Flutter Futures hanging on OpenHarmony (CookieManager, WebViewChannelDelegate, HeadlessInAppWebViewManager, CredentialDatabaseHandler, InAppWebViewManager). ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed onInterceptRequest lacking top-level exception protection causing WebView resource-load crashes; failures now safely return null. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed takeScreenshot rect crop ignoring pixel density due to `??` operator precedence, and fixed Dart-side screenshot byte list decoding. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed HeadlessInAppWebView controller wrapping creating duplicate wrappers; reuse wrappers via Expando. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed WebMessageChannel / WebMessageListener ARRAY_BUFFER and message type handling on OpenHarmony. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed WebStorage evaluateJavascript result parsing for int/String/JSON values on OpenHarmony. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed PullToRefreshController calling platform APIs after dispose. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed CredentialDatabase / ContentBlockerHandler / ClientCertUtil resource-leak and exception paths (RDB init, HTTP destroy, file close). ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed napi_init.cpp missing status checks for uv event loop and property definition. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Added ProxyController, ProcessGlobalConfig, WebViewEnvironment, ClientCertUtil and related OpenHarmony implementations. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Improved plugin lifecycle stability on OpenHarmony (dispose, pending JS dialog cancel, InAppBrowserSession). ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Expanded unit/platform tests and Example Demo pages (001–038), including exception / permission DENY / concurrent / boundary scenarios. ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Updated OpenHarmony documentation (version table for Flutter 3.22 / 3.27 / 3.35, migration guide, WebMessageChannel/WebMessageListener API reference). ([#308](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/308))
* Fixed onZoomScaleChanged callback type casting and adapted test URLs for Chinese network environment on OpenHarmony. ([#298](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/298))
* Fixed programmatic zoom scale integration test and zoomBy error handling on OpenHarmony. ([#296](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/296))
* Fixed onPermissionRequest callback triggering order and supported Camera/Microphone permission requests on OpenHarmony. ([#294](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/294))
* Fixed evaluateJavaScriptWithContentWorld handler incorrectly parsing JSON result object causing timeout on OpenHarmony. ([#292](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/292))
* Fixed window.open() blocking and goBack failure on OpenHarmony. ([#290](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/290))
* Fixed setCustomUserAgent not affecting navigator.userAgent in JavaScript context on OpenHarmony. ([#288](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/288))
* Fixed webViewPackage info retrieval on OpenHarmony. ([#259](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/259))
* Fixed print functionality on OpenHarmony. ([#261](https://gitcode.com/CPF-Flutter/flutter_inappwebview/pull/261))
